data.term.more: More in the list of terms
data.term.duelo.name: duel
data.term.duelo.def: The new version plays many games against the current one. It only goes live if it wins.
data.term.rede.name: neural network
data.term.rede.def: A program made of layers of simple sums. Each layer takes numbers, mixes them with the weights and passes them on. The last one points to the move.
data.term.peso.name: weights
data.term.peso.def: The numbers inside the network. Training nudges each one up or down a little, millions of times, until the choices get good.
data.term.imitacao.name: imitation
data.term.imitacao.def: Training by copying another player's choices. It gives Zap a decent start before it learns on its own.
data.term.regras.name: rules player
data.term.regras.def: A program with fixed, hand written rules, like “play the lowest card that wins”. It learns nothing by itself. The technical name is heuristic.
data.term.ajustado.name: tuned rules player
data.term.ajustado.def: The same rules player, with the numbers in its rules tuned by search. The technical name is tuned heuristic. It is the ruler used in training.
data.term.recompensa.name: reward
data.term.recompensa.def: The signal that tells Zap whether a move was good: how much it changed the chance of winning the match. If the chance goes up, it gains points; if it drops, it loses.
data.term.treinador.name: coach
data.term.treinador.def: A part used only in training. It sees everyone's cards and estimates how much each move was worth. When Zap plays with you, it stays out.
data.term.etapas.name: steps
data.term.etapas.def: Each step is one training round: Zap plays, collects {k} decisions and adjusts its weights with them. The technical name is iteration.
data.term.margem.name: margin
data.term.margem.def: How much the number can move by luck alone.
data.term.dup.name: duplicate pairs
data.term.dup.def: Each deal is played twice, with the teams swapping seats. Card luck cancels out and what is left is the difference in play.
data.term.ic.name: 95% interval
data.term.ic.def: The range where the true value almost surely is. If the measurement were repeated 100 times, about 95 of those ranges would contain the true value.
data.term.ic80.name: 80% margin
data.term.ic80.def: The range where the true value is in 8 out of 10 cases. The more you play, the narrower it gets.
data.term.blefe.name: bluff
data.term.blefe.def: Calling truco with a weak hand, so the other side runs.
data.term.provas.name: evidence
data.term.provas.def: What Zap has seen from an opponent in this game: hands in which they called truco and bets they answered.
data.term.populacao.name: population value
data.term.populacao.def: Where the reading starts: how people at these tables play on average. Until there are enough people, it comes from Zap's games against the training cast.
data.term.semleitura.name: without reading
data.term.semleitura.def: The same Zap with reading switched off. Everything the same, except what it sees of its opponents.
data.term.gemea.name: twin
data.term.gemea.def: A version trained the same way and for the same time, without the change we want to measure. The difference between the two shows what the change brought.
data.term.explorador.name: explorer
data.term.explorador.def: An opponent built to fool the reading: a scripted player that fakes a style and switches, or a network trained against it.
data.term.ruido.name: noise
data.term.ruido.def: The variation that comes from the luck of the cards alone. A difference smaller than the noise may be zero.
data.term.faixa.name: band
data.term.faixa.def: Where your level probably is. It starts wide and narrows with each game.

data.h1.people: Zap learned truco against itself. Now it learns from the people who play.
